title: Launch Checklist — Customer-visible Model Changelog (Schema v1 + Generator + Console/Docs)
body:
Owner: Talia Benson (Program)
Last reviewed with: Marissa (PM), Dylan (Eng sponsor), Connor (Release Eng), Elliot (Docs), Dev (Support), Logan (Obs), Marcus/Naomi (Security/Compliance)

Scope of launch checklist
- Model Metadata Schema v1 stored in model registry
- Change-event emission + changelog generator (draft -> in_review -> published)
- Publish targets: Docs site “Model release notes” + Console “Changelog” tab + API/SDK surfaces (model_version + changelog_url)
- Auditability: who changed/published what, retention, immutable history / supersede flow

Launch tiers
- Private beta: select enterprise + design partners (console gated + feed endpoint gated)
- GA: all customers (hosted) with staged rollout to Dedicated/Private customers per account tier

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A) Go/No-Go prerequisites (must be complete before any customer enablement)

A1. Product sign-off (PM)
[ ] Release note taxonomy finalized (bugfix / perf / compatibility / deprecation) and required sections per type (PM-801)
    - Owner: Marissa Cole
    - Acceptance: template renders include “Impact”, “Compatibility”, and “Links” every time; deprecations include timeline + replacement.
[ ] Approval workflow SLA defined (draft -> in_review -> published; emergency publish path) (PM-803)
    - Owner: Marissa Cole + Paula Mendes

A2. Engineering readiness
[ ] Schema v1 validation in registry enforced in prod (required fields + constraints)
    - Owner: Quentin Harris
    - Verify: rejects missing model_id/version_id/provenance/compat; clear error messages.
[ ] Change events emitted for create/update/deprecate with actor + timestamp + event_id
    - Owner: Michael Nguyen
    - Verify: deterministic ordering; multiple updates/day don’t collapse incorrectly.
[ ] public_changelog_fields allowlist + redaction logic verified
    - Owner: Jordan Lee
    - Verify: internal-only fields never appear in draft or published output; CI/linters green.
[ ] Changelog generator service deployed + can write drafts + publish artifacts
    - Owner: Michael Nguyen
    - Verify: can re-render a draft; publish produces stable URLs; retry behavior documented.

A3. Console + docs readiness
[ ] Console UI behind feature flag + tier gating (beta list)
    - Owner: Chloe Martin
    - Verify: “Changelog” tab visible only when flag enabled; version pages link to published entry.
[ ] Docs site IA + pages live in staging + navigation reviewed
    - Owner: Elliot Price + Wei Chen
    - Verify: per-model landing page, filters by date/version, canonical URL scheme.
[ ] RSS/Atom + JSON feed endpoints validated (rate limited, ETags)
    - Owner: Elliot Price + Brian Murphy

A4. Security/compliance readiness
[ ] Audit event mapping reviewed (metadata create/update/deprecate + publish/supersede)
    - Owner: Kevin Osei + Marcus Lin
    - Verify: events include actor, reason (when required), before/after hashes or references, and retention policy documented.
[ ] RBAC roles configured + tested in prod
    - Owner: Kaitlyn Nguyen
    - Verify: editors vs approvers vs publishers; least privilege; break-glass path documented.
[ ] Retention/immutability statement finalized for enterprise questionnaires
    - Owner: Olga Petrov + Naomi Feldman

A5. Support readiness prerequisites
[ ] Support playbook created: “Where do I find model changes?”, “Why did my outputs change?”, “How to pin version?”, “How to subscribe to feed?”
    - Owner: Dev Patel
[ ] Known gaps documented (e.g., incomplete historical entries pre-migration) + approved customer messaging
    - Owner: Dev Patel + Elliot Price

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
B) Communications plan (internal + external)

B1. Internal comms (pre-beta)
[ ] Slack announcement draft to #eng-platform, #product, #support: what’s launching, how to request enablement, how approvals work
    - Owner: Talia Benson
    - Include: link to runbook + style guide + beta request process.
[ ] Sales/CS enablement note: how to describe feature, limitations, and timelines
    - Owner: Talia Benson + Dev Patel

B2. Customer comms (beta)
[ ] Beta email template for selected accounts (enterprise-friendly):
    - What changes they’ll see
    - Where to find changelog in Console + docs
    - How to subscribe to RSS/JSON feed
    - How to provide feedback / escalation path
    - Owner: Marissa Cole + Ava Chen (for enterprise tone), reviewed by Dev Patel
[ ] In-product Console announcement banner for flagged accounts (optional)
    - Owner: Paula Mendes + Kenji Nakamura

B3. GA comms
[ ] Docs “What’s new” entry + short blog-style changelog launch announcement (optional)
    - Owner: Wei Chen
[ ] Update API docs for model_version + changelog_url exposure (OpenAI-compatible routes)
    - Owner: Brian Murphy + Monica Patel (SDK messaging)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
C) Documentation updates (must be ready before GA; recommended before beta)

[ ] Public docs: Model release notes landing page + per-model pages
    - Owner: Elliot Price
    - Checklist:
      - URL format stable (no internal names)
      - Includes “How to interpret entries” section
      - Includes link to policy: deprecation timelines & expectations

[ ] Dedicated/Private docs updates referencing changelog + change-management expectations
    - Owner: Kira Thompson
    - Checklist:
      - Clarify that Dedicated/Private may have pinned versions and scheduled rollout windows
      - Clarify support process for urgent hotfix notes

[ ] SDK docs/examples updated (Python + TS): surfaced model_version + changelog_url
    - Owner: Ibrahim Khan
    - Checklist:
      - Example output objects
      - Backward compatibility note (if any fields renamed)

[ ] Style linting for release notes templates enforced in CI
    - Owner: Wei Chen

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
D) Feature flag + rollout plan

Flags (names are placeholders; confirm exact names in control plane/config)
- console_model_changelog_enabled
- public_changelog_feed_enabled
- api_changelog_url_header_enabled
- sdk_model_version_exposure_enabled

D1. Beta (week 1)
[ ] Enable for 3–5 design partners (mix of Hosted + Dedicated), include at least one regulated customer if available
    - Owner: Dylan Brooks + Paula Mendes
[ ] Verify publish flow end-to-end in production with a low-risk model update (or a controlled test model)
    - Owner: Connor O'Brien + Michael Nguyen
[ ] Confirm helpdesk macros and escalation path are live
    - Owner: Dev Patel

D2. Expanded beta (week 2–3)
[ ] Add remaining accounts that explicitly requested transparency (from CS spreadsheet)
    - Owner: Ava Chen + Dev Patel
[ ] Monitor generator edit rate; tune templates and redactions if needed
    - Owner: Elliot Price + Marissa Cole

D3. GA (week 4)
[ ] Enable flags for all Hosted accounts
    - Owner: Dylan Brooks
[ ] Decide Dedicated/Private default posture:
    - Option A: enable by default for all Dedicated/Private
    - Option B: enable on request initially (if enterprise-specific review is needed)
    - Owner: Marissa Cole + Vivek Kulkarni

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
E) Support enablement + operational readiness

E1. Support training (before beta)
[ ] 30-min training session (recorded):
    - how to find changelog entry
    - how to confirm resolved model_version
    - what to do when an entry is missing/incorrect
    - Owner: Dev Patel + Owen Phillips

E2. Ticket routing and escalation (before beta)
[ ] Define escalation labels and routing rules:
    - “model-changelog-missing-entry” -> Platform
    - “model-changelog-wording” -> Docs/PM
    - “model-changelog-audit” -> Security/Compliance
    - Owner: Dev Patel

E3. Runbooks (before GA)
[ ] Generator runbook published and on-call knows rollback/supersede procedure
    - Owner: Connor O'Brien
[ ] Console/docs 404 playbook (docs publish lag, link mismatch)
    - Owner: Elliot Price + Chloe Martin

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
F) Monitoring, metrics, and post-launch review

F1. Dashboards + alerts (must be live before beta)
[ ] Generator health dashboard:
    - publish lag p50/p95
    - validation failures by type
    - docs sync failures
    - approvals backlog (draft/in_review age)
    - Owner: Logan Wright
[ ] Customer-facing errors:
    - feed endpoint error rate, cache hit rate, 5xx
    - Console changelog tab load errors
    - Owner: Logan Wright + Chloe Martin

F2. Success metrics (track weekly; report at 2 weeks post-GA)
[ ] Support ticket reduction:
    - baseline: count tickets tagged “model behavior changed/rollout confusion”
    - target: -25% within 60 days of GA
    - Owner: Dev Patel
[ ] Adoption:
    - % of active customers viewing changelog tab
    - # of RSS/Atom subscribers (proxy via feed requests + ETags)
    - % of API responses where client consumes model_version field (via SDK telemetry where allowed)
    - Owner: Paula Mendes + Monica Patel
[ ] Quality of notes:
    - % of changes requiring manual edits (goal: <30% after 1 month)
    - median time draft -> published
    - Owner: Marissa Cole + Elliot Price

F3. Post-launch review (PLR)
[ ] Schedule PLR for 2 weeks after GA
    - Attendees: PM/Eng/Docs/Support/Sec
    - Agenda:
      - Top issues
      - Template adjustments
      - Flag default decisions for Dedicated/Private
      - Next-scope: better eval links, per-customer views (explicitly out of scope for v1)
    - Owner: Talia Benson

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
G) Rollback / correction plan (must be agreed before beta)

[ ] Correction (“supersede”) flow validated:
    - published entry can be superseded with corrected entry
    - history preserved + timestamps/actor recorded
    - old entry remains accessible (or redirected) with “superseded” label
    - Owner: Jada Williams + Kevin Osei

[ ] Emergency stop:
    - disable public feeds and console tab via flags
    - generator continues to draft but does not publish
    - Owner: Dylan Brooks (decision) + on-call (execution)

[ ] Customer comms for corrections:
    - standard wording: “We corrected the release note for <model/version> published on <date> to clarify <what>. No change to the underlying model binaries unless explicitly stated.”
    - Owner: Elliot Price + Marissa Cole

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
H) Final Go/No-Go checklist (day-of GA)

[ ] All P0 alerts green for 24h
[ ] At least 3 successful publishes in prod with real change events
[ ] Docs links validated from Console in prod (no 404s)
[ ] Support macros live + training complete
[ ] Security sign-off on audit events + retention language
[ ] PM sign-off on customer-facing templates + prohibited content checks

Decision + approver
- GA Go/No-Go meeting owner: Talia Benson
- Final decision: Marissa Cole (PM) + Dylan Brooks (Eng)

Notes / open items
- Confirm whether JSON feed is available unauthenticated or requires API key (default proposal: public but rate-limited; enterprise option: authenticated feed for account-specific filtering).
- Confirm “historical backfill cutoff date” messaging (how far back we can reliably generate notes).
- Confirm Dedicated/Private: whether changelog shown in Console for Private deployments with customer-managed control plane (linking strategy may differ).
